body: Looks like letting winit pull from git (which results in winit version 0.27.0) resolves this error.
I'm going to reopen this; this is incredibly useful information for us and pushes me to upgrade that dependency ASAP.
Awesome! Glad I can help. I think ultimately it was the mixed up android-ndk versions that was causing the issue.

We added an `ndk_context` crate to solve this in the Java VM/env scenarios, but Bevy needs direct access to `native_activity()`s `asset_manager()`:

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/a011f4d53cdfc3e779ac6500a60e70cabf652956/crates/bevy_asset/src/io/android_asset_io.rs#L25

Afaik @dvc94ch's recommendation is to also retrieve this through Java/JNI using `ndk_context` directly if possible, because a "better" solution has only been found too invasive thus far.

https://github.com/rust-windowing/android-ndk-rs/pull/280

issue.body:
# Objective

- Upgrading ndk-glue (our Android interop layer) desynchronized us from winit
- This further broke Android builds, see #4905 (oops...)
- Reverting to 0.5 should help with this, until the new `winit` version releases
- Fixes #4774 and closes #4529

body: To be clear, my position is that we need to be activity inclusive. There is a large diversity of activities besides the NativeActivity, like the GameActivity from the android game development kit. We need to stand up against systemic activity phobia.
With the recent effort around `GameActivity` I do hope we can come up with a generic interface that exposes the similarities.
